text: Oh, hi! Welcome to the cafe. Sit anywhere you like, and I'll bring you a menu.
Careful with that sword. The last person who swung it broke a lamp.
Good morning! What can I get you?
A latte, please. And one of those croissants.
Morning, Mira! You are early today.
Of course. One latte, coming right up.
Fresh beans this morning. Enjoy it.
Five years this spring. Feels like longer some days.
See you tomorrow, Mira. Good luck today!
I could not sleep. Could I get a latte, please?
How long have you had this place?
Do you ever get a day off?
I should get going. See you tomorrow!
